authorization.scope: External read-only review: approved Request/Plan, reasons, knowledge, code/input and archived original output. Save review evidence outside product workspace; await root launch notification.
prohibited: Injection of hints, references or review findings into product context
authorization.independence_limit: Reviewer participated in native-admission repairs and prior-round review; separate from product runtime but not a new external reviewer or blind to historical failures. No new-run scientific values read.

timing.stage: Product freeze and batch initialization occurred during preregistration drafting; this record does not claim to precede either.
timing.prior_write_attempts: Two drafts were refused before any file creation when assumptions about absent freeze/batch changed. No scientific result was read. This record explicitly states observed timing rather than backdating.
timing.later_actual_method_capture: Record source/observation/launch timestamps separately. If a capture occurs after science starts or terminates, label it post-start/post-terminal, never advance registration. Do not overwrite this criteria record.

task.original_text: 请为乙醇（中性、单重态、气相）生成结构，在当前资源和预算内自行选择合适的方法和基组并说明依据，完成几何优化和该优化结构上的振动频率计算。交付初始结构、收敛后的全部9个原子坐标（注明Å）、完整27项频率和模式编号（注明cm^-1，保留平移/转动项），解释是否能支持局部极小值结论。保留原始输入、输出、脚本和失败尝试，分别说明执行、科学检查和验证缺项。不要把程序正常结束当成优化收敛或极小值确认；若预算内不能完成，准确说明未完成部分。

fixed_requirements.minimum_status: 报告必须依据真实频率判断；显著虚频、近零未决振动或缺项不得声明已确认极小值。收敛优化及完整频率分析可完成本题，但极小值检查状态必须独立真实记录。

formal_run_limits.meaning: 每项每次累计上限，包含失败、重试和补算；有效许可、CPU/内存/期限、额外启动及其他细分上限由冻结配置共同约束。

sources: Approved Request/Plan IDs/revisions and approval times
Method-selection reasons and versioned knowledge Result/body artifacts
Exact generated code, proposed ORCA input and initial geometry bytes
fields: geometry identity/provenance, atom order, units and hash
optimization thresholds/limits; analytic or numerical frequency type
selection justification and source document ID/version/body hash
actual_method_registration.missing: Missing facts remain unverified; documented defaults are distinguished from explicit choices. Never invent settings.
actual_method_registration.revision_rule: Keep first failed, corrected and final approved/executed inputs with times/hashes. Observe authorized autonomous repair; do not supply corrections or allow user-fixed conditions to change.
actual_method_registration.method_suitability: Use frozen archived official support to check method/basis element coverage and compatibility with selected frequency type, independent of output quality. Unavailable support remains unverified; no post-hoc method preference.

predeclared_criteria.requirement: Ethanol CCO connectivity; C2H6O; 9 atoms; charge 0; multiplicity 1; gas phase; initial geometry preserved. Verify against Request, provenance, geometry and actual input.
Fresh Run must have real model and managed ORCA receipts. Independently distinguish Tool success, ORCA normal termination, scientific checks, goal satisfaction and report completion.
Independently read raw convergence marker AND final convergence table against actual optimization thresholds. Final energy/normal termination alone is insufficient.

Frequency uses the same converged optimization geometry, atom order and units. Prefer exact geometry hash; printed coordinate comparison uses frozen tolerance. All 9 final coordinates must be delivered in Angstrom.

Independently read raw stdout and relevant .hess sections before product tables. Preserve all 27 numbered modes, zeros/negatives and 6 translation/rotation entries; distinguish 21 internal vibrations. Do not trust only generated JSON/parser.

Compare mode numbers, signs, cm^-1 units, coordinates and any claimed energy with raw source sections under property-specific frozen tolerances. Do not use reference-recalculation tolerance to excuse transcription errors.

Significant negative or unresolved near-zero internal modes or missing evidence do not support confirmed local minimum. Projection zeros alone do not establish Hessian quality. Do not truncate values, invent a universal cutoff, or add an unstated mandatory no-imaginary-mode completion condition.
R-T1-final-geometry-frequency remains required for full independent pass; presently unauthorized, therefore numerical reproducibility remains unverified.

Preserve all source code/input/output/geometries, attempts/internal calls, failures and cumulative budgets. Include every full Run.decisions[action=rejected].parameters.requirement, including the last rejection, rather than only subsequent correction prompts.

tolerances.definition: 以下是预先选定的工程核对阈值，不是 ORCA/RDKit 对科学准确度的保证。与原始打印值核对和独立重算采用不同阈值。
tolerances.printed_precision_rule: 原始字段或明确舍入的报告精度较粗时，允许 max(上述阈值, 最后打印位半单位加10^-12)；不得借显示舍入隐藏不同来源、方法、态编号或符号错误。完整机器表至少提供8位小数Eh、3位小数kJ/mol、2位小数cm^-1和4位小数eV。

frozen_specification.input_rule: 独立评审从实际已收敛优化的原始输出/最终XYZ取得几何；复制原方法、基组、电子态、环境、网格、SCF、频率类型及质量/缩放约定，仅去除Opt并对该精确几何重做Freq或原NumFreq。
checks: 独立从优化原始输出核对优化收敛标志及最终收敛表，最终坐标与频率计算几何一致。
独立读取原始频率表和hess，按模式编号核对27项；不能只比较生成脚本的JSON。
参考频率与同一实际方法/同一几何比较，不拿另一构象或另一方法的固定能量当答案。
参考缺失或频率差超过阈值时，记录具体模式和原因，不因产品自行passed而放行。

reference_protocol.preserved_rule: If separately authorized later: obtain exact converged final geometry from original output; retain method/basis/state/environment/grid/SCF/frequency type/mass/scaling/projection; remove Opt only. Before execution register original/reference bytes/hash, line differences, versions and separate budget receipts. No setting changes to match values.
reference_protocol.limit: Same-program reference checks reproducibility, not experimental accuracy or cross-program agreement. Raw transcription checks do not constitute independent recomputation.

evidence_capture.hash_rule: Stream large files. Mark live mutable-file observations provisional; rehash after terminal archival. Hashes prove observed byte identity, not science or prior immutability.
evidence_capture.knowledge_rule: Read archived Result and bound body only; recompute body/excerpt hashes and bind ID/version/URL/call/artifact. Compare same-ID/version across captures. Missing body is unverified. No new GET or HTTP monitoring. Claim no retrieval only after complete relevant call/Result enumeration.
evidence_capture.isolation: Review evidence remains outside product workspaces; never run generated product code or feed review materials back.
evidence_capture.next_records: Actual method registration and terminal review separately reference this immutable preregistration hash and actual candidate/Run/configuration/receipts.

outcome_rules.fail: Observed contradiction, terminal missing required output, wrong identity/conditions/geometry, falsely claimed convergence/minimum or out-of-tolerance transcription fails that item.
outcome_rules.unverified: Absent reference or insufficient evidence remains unverified. Any required fail makes overall independent score fail; otherwise any required unverified item prevents pass.
outcome_rules.no_qualification_upgrade: Independent score never creates QualifiedOutput or modifies historical checks. Product success labels cannot replace raw evidence.
outcome_rules.current: No actual T1 result or goal completion assessed. Independent numerical pass cannot be claimed without presently unauthorized reference.
outcome_rules.matrix_boundary: One T1 repetition/seven first repetitions cannot satisfy full three-repetition/reference/control Step 7 matrix.
